(
	i/process
	i/fs
	i/stdio
	i/fail
	i/core
	i/bit_array
	i/json
	i/list
	i/int
	(Some, None) = i/option
	(Process, Fs, Stdio) = i/process
)

read_manifest = (path) {
	fs.read_file(path) |>
		(Ok(bytes)) {
			bit_array.to_string(bytes) |>
				(Ok(text)) {
					json.parse(text) |>
						(Ok(value)) {
							json.as_array(value) |>
								(Some(items)) {
									list.try_map(items, json.as_string) |>
										(Ok(paths)) { Ok(paths) }
										& (Error(_)) { Error("invalid manifest") }
								}
								& (None) { Error("invalid manifest") }
						}
						& (Error(_)) { Error("invalid manifest") }
				}
				& (Error(_)) { Error("invalid manifest") }
		}
		& (Error(_)) { Error("manifest read failed") }
}

append_sources = (paths, file, total) {
	paths |>
		([]) { Ok(total) }
		& ([path, ..rest]) {
			fs.read_file(path) |>
				(Ok(bytes)) {
					fs.open(file, fs.Append) |>
						(Ok(handle)) {
							write_result = fail.catch(() { fs.write(handle, bytes) })
							close_result = fail.catch(() { fs.close(handle) })
							write_result |>
								(Ok(_)) {
									close_result |>
										(Ok(_)) {
											append_sources(
												rest,
												file,
												total + core.bit_size(bytes) / 8,
											)
										}
										& (Error(_)) { Error("write failed") }
								}
								& (Error(_)) {
									close_result
									Error("write failed")
								}
						}
						& (Error(_)) { Error("open failed") }
				}
				& (Error(_)) { Error("read failed") }
		}
}

run_job = (paths, destination, part) {
	fail.catch(() {
		fs.write_file(part, <<>>)
		append_sources(paths, part, 0) |>
			(Ok(total)) {
				fs.rename(part, destination)
				Ok(total)
			}
			& (Error(_)) { Error("copy failed") }
	})
}

main = () <- (process : Process, fs : Fs, stdio : Stdio) {
	process.args() |>
		(Ok([manifest, destination])) {
			read_manifest(manifest) |>
				(Ok(paths)) {
					lock = destination <> ".lock"
					part = destination <> ".part"
					fs.mkdir(lock) |>
						(Ok(_)) {
							run_job(paths, destination, part) |>
								(Ok(total)) { stdio.print("OK " <> int.to_string(total)) }
								& (Error(_)) { stdio.print("ERROR") }
							fail.catch(() { fs.remove(part) })
							fail.catch(() { fs.remove(lock) })
						}
						& (Error(_)) { stdio.print("ERROR") }
				}
				& (Error(_)) { stdio.print("ERROR") }
		}
		& (_) { stdio.print("ERROR") }
}
